category.name: Whiteboards and UI design
category.description: Collaborative visual thinking, sketching and interface design; whiteboard and UI-design mappings are distinct.
category.audience: Cross-functional workshop participants, product teams, designers and engineers.
category.audienceRationale: Whiteboarding spans operations, marketing and product collaboration; professional interface design has a narrower designer/developer audience.

pricing.note: Starter per member monthly equivalent, billed yearly; free plan also exists.
Professional Full seat monthly equivalent with annual billing; free Starter also exists.
Professional Collab seat monthly equivalent with annual billing; covers FigJam, not Figma Design editing.

oss.name: Penpot
locked: Enterprise centralized administration, multi-organization management and advanced team/user permissions
Enterprise SSO/identity governance and extended recovery/version retention
oss.classificationReason: Core Professional edition is MPL-2.0 and self-hostable with all design/prototyping features and unlimited users/teams/files. Current self-host pricing explicitly gates governance extras; hosted storage limits are separate service limits.

health.rsx: Overall score 6.3/10. Activity 6.0, maintenance 10.0, security 0.0, and license 10.0 are the main decision signals.

oss.name: Excalidraw
locked: Excalidraw+ comments, presentations and PDF/PPTX frame export
Excalidraw+ workspace access management and team organization
oss.classificationReason: MIT editor and app source are available. Commercial Plus adds workflow features as well as cloud persistence; cloud storage alone is not the reason for C. Self-host collaboration requires separately configured backend services.

health.rsx: Overall score 6.8/10. Activity 4.8, maintenance 9.0, security 4.9, and license 10.0 are the main decision signals.

oss.name: tldraw SDK
locked: Production deployment requires an active trial, commercial or hobby license key; default source license permits development only
oss.classificationReason: Current default core license is custom, development-only and not OSI OSS. SDK can be deployed with separately granted production rights; public tldraw.com is a hosted application, not proof of OSS rights.

health.rsx: Overall score 6.8/10. Activity 7.1, maintenance 10.0, security 5.6, and license 3.0 are the main decision signals.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Interface design/prototyping alternative; evaluate Figma file conversion, libraries, plugins and developer handoff before migration. No lossless import or full feature parity claimed.

Sketching and diagramming alternative for simpler whiteboards. Excalidraw supports its own JSON and image exports; no native lossless Miro import verified. Miro integrations/facilitation workflows require separate review.
Collaborative sketching alternative; not a Figma Design editor. Excalidraw JSON/PNG/SVG portability does not establish native FigJam import, voting or workshop feature parity.

exclusions.name: tldraw SDK (OSS recommendations)
exclusions.reason: Custom development-only default license; retained as S comparison record, excluded from OSS recommendations and paid-to-OSS edges.

uncertainties: Penpot self-host pricing inconsistently labels audit logs as available versus coming soon; omitted from confirmed locked list.
Excalidraw separately configured collaboration infrastructure not deployment-tested.
